segments.text: NLSH lets you talk to your terminal like a person. Type list all Python files and it gives you the find command. Type get
commit with message fixed bug and it writes it out. One curl command installs it. Works on Mac and Linux. Basically chatgpt for your shell but actually
useful. Doesn't lecture you about best practices. just spits out the command you
